overview: ICP Portal is a mobile-first ICP workspace with an iOS-style Home screen, Files, Notes, Calculator, an app directory and settings, backed by per-user private storage.
features: iOS-style Home screen with app grid, folders, favourites, search and a customizable dock
Files app with folders, upload, preview, rename, move, copy and delete
Automatic image compression and a per-file upload size limit
Inline previews for images, PDFs, video, audio, text, JSON, CSV and DOCX
Notes, Calculator and a curated ICP app directory
Internet Identity sign-in with a private per-user workspace
